title: Gloss
description: Gloss: a JSON format for PDF annotations. Coordinates are PDF user space in points, origin bottom-left, before /Rotate.

Rect.title: Rect
Rect.description: A rectangle in PDF user space, given by its bottom-left corner and its size. XFDF writes it as x1,y1,x2,y2.

Intent.title: Intent
Intent.description: What a mark is for, such as a callout or an arrow (XFDF intent, PDF /IT). One of FreeText, FreeTextCallout, FreeTextTypeWriter, LineArrow, LineDimension, PolygonCloud, PolygonDimension, PolyLineDimension. Any other PDF name is allowed and is kept unchanged.

type.description: The annotation type, such as highlight or note. Readers keep a type they don't know.

id.description: Unique within the document. Never reused for a different annotation.

page.description: The page the annotation is on, counted from 0.

rect.description: The bounding box, in PDF user space.

contents.description: The annotation's text, such as a comment or a note.

inReplyTo.description: The id of the annotation this one replies to. Replies form threads.

createdAt.description: When the annotation was made, as an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. XFDF writes a PDF date string (D:20261019120000Z).

modifiedAt.description: When the annotation last changed, as an ISO 8601 date-time with an offset. XFDF writes a PDF date string.

subject.description: A short label for what the mark is.

intent.description: What the mark is for, such as a callout or an arrow.

custom.description: Data of your own. Gloss readers keep it as it is and never interpret it.

Common.title: Common
Common.description: The fields every annotation accepts. Each annotation type lists them alongside its own, and a schema of your own can refer to this definition.

Quad.title: Quad
Quad.description: A quadrilateral over a run of text, its corners in the order PDF uses for /QuadPoints. It need not be axis-aligned.

y.description: Vertical position in points, measured up from the bottom.

Point.title: Point
Point.description: A point in PDF user space: points, origin bottom-left, before /Rotate.

left.description: Inset from the left edge in points.

top.description: Inset from the top edge in points.

right.description: Inset from the right edge in points.

bottom.description: Inset from the bottom edge in points.

Fringe.title: Fringe
Fringe.description: Insets from an annotation's rect to the area it draws in, in points (PDF /RD, XFDF fringe, both in this order).

Dashes.title: Dashes
Dashes.description: A dash pattern in points: lengths on, then off, repeating. Absent means a solid line (XFDF dashes, PDF /D).

LineEnding.title: LineEnding
LineEnding.description: The shape drawn at the end of a line (XFDF head and tail, PDF /LE). One of None, Square, Circle, Diamond, OpenArrow, ClosedArrow, Butt, ROpenArrow, RClosedArrow, Slash. Any other PDF name is allowed and is kept unchanged.

NoteIcon.title: NoteIcon
NoteIcon.description: The icon a note shows on the page (XFDF icon, PDF /Name). One of Comment, Note, Help, Insert, Key, NewParagraph, Paragraph. Any other PDF name is allowed and is kept unchanged.
